task_completion.description: The Screaming Frog SEO Spider application is launched and visible on the desktop.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Screaming Frog GUI window is open, showing the main interface with the 'Enter URL to spider' field.

task_completion.description: The target URL is entered into the address bar of Screaming Frog.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The URL 'https://crawler-test.com/links/broken_links' (or the functional variants like /links/broken_links_internal) is typed into the top address bar.

task_completion.description: The agent initiates the crawl and the progress bar indicates activity.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Start' button is clicked, and the progress bar at the top right shows a percentage or '100%' completion.

task_completion.description: The agent identifies at least one 404 error in the crawl results.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Response Codes' tab is selected, and at least one row shows a 'Status Code' of 404.

task_completion.description: The agent filters or selects the Client Error (4xx) report for export.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Response Codes' tab is active, and the filter dropdown is set to 'Client Error (4xx)'.

task_completion.description: The agent initiates the export process for the 4xx report.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file save dialog is visible, showing the destination path '/home/ga/Documents/broken_links.csv' being entered or confirmed.

integrity.description: The agent used the Screaming Frog GUI rather than just terminal commands to generate the file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks, and interactions within the Screaming Frog interface rather than just a terminal window.

integrity.description: The results shown in the GUI match the expected site structure of crawler-test.com.
integrity.visual_evidence: The internal tab shows URLs containing 'crawler-test.com' and specific paths like '/links/not_found/'.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply create a CSV file using a text editor or 'touch' command.
integrity.visual_evidence: The export process is seen through the Screaming Frog 'Export' button and file dialog, not a text editor like Gedit or Vim.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target URL provided in the prompt (https://crawler-test.com/links/broken_links) returns a 404 error itself. To successfully find broken links *on* the site, the agent may need to crawl the functional versions: https://crawler-test.com/links/broken_links_internal or https://crawler-test.com/links/broken_links_external. A successful crawl will show broken links such as those under the path '/links/not_found/foo*'. The final report must be a CSV located at /home/ga/Documents/broken_links.csv.
